text: はっ　はあ　はあ…　これで　おもいのこす　ことは　ない　おぬしに　すべて　たくした　からな　あとは　じいさんの　おむかえを　まつ　ばかりじゃ…

structure.jp: はっ　はあ　はあ…
これで　おもいのこす　ことは　ない
structure.en: with this, I have nothing left to regret

structure.jp: おぬしに　すべて　たくした　からな
structure.en: because I entrusted everything to you

structure.jp: じいさんの　おむかえを　まつ　ばかりじゃ…
structure.en: is just to wait for this old man's final call...

patterns.name: 〜ばかりだ
patterns.explanation: ばかりだ after a plain verb says that doing it is the only thing left. じゃ is the old-man だ. まつ　ばかりじゃ = 'all that's left is to wait'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a sentence gives the reason, here for what was said just before. たくした　からな = 'because I've entrusted it, you see'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おもいのこす　こと
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. おもいのこす　こと = 'things to look back on with regret'.
